BL-1787 — A closed owner's pure-evidence or doc stray that the land step can neither cherry-pick nor prove superseded (BL-1670 grounds a/b, BL-1768 ground c) aborts the whole replay today, so a stray on paths the landing ticket never touched turns EVERY land into LAND_ESCALATE and a condition (g) hand build (BL-1657 and three more on 2026-09-20; BL-1748, BL-1764, BL-1704, BL-1766 and BL-1749 on 2026-09-26, each after a 20-40 min walk): when none of the stray's paths is one of the landing ticket's own, the step leaves it unlanded, prints LAND_STRAY_DEFERRED naming it, and still builds, verifies and records the landing ticket's own commit
What it solves: ## Why
Approval context: FIRM: the landing ticket's own land never waits on content that is not the landing ticket's. FIRM: a deferred stray is never landed, never reported superseded, and never reported LANDED_SIBLING; it is named on one LAND_STRAY_DEFERRED line on every land that meets it, and QA sends the specifier one …
BL-1787 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1787" (or "reject BL-1787 <reason>") to act.
